advice_items.quote: I sold everything and now I'm starting over with an app actually. So you got to have some balls to do this.
advice_items.summary_en: Be bold enough to sell everything and start over in a new venture.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于清零重来并冒风险开创新事业

advice_items.quote: You want to own the factory, right? If you own the factory, then everything else is a pop-up... your competitors also become your customers.
advice_items.summary_en: Own the central production facility so stores stay small and competitors buy wholesale from you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 掌控中心工厂并向竞争对手提供批发服务

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: I moved from that to tech. You know why? Because there's no money like tech.
advice_items.summary_en: Pivot into industries like tech that offer unmatched upside and scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 果断切入天花板更高的科技等高回报行业

advice_items.quote: Be more interested than interesting. If you're in the room and you want to be the big star, then you're going to miss an opportunity.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on listening and learning in the room rather than trying to impress others.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多倾听他人而非急于表现自己以抓住机会

advice_items.quote: If you want to really be a millionaire, this shit's going to take time... we're talking sustainability... That's not going to happen overnight.
advice_items.summary_en: Build sustainable wealth over years rather than chasing overnight hype.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别迷信一夜暴富而要打造长期可持续的财富

advice_items.quote: Stay who you are. Don't be a weirdo. You haven't been driving a Lambo. Why do you want one now? ... I drive a Kia.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid buying flashy cars, $10,000 steaks, or overpriced status symbols after making money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 致富后保持本色别为虚荣买豪车等奢侈品

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Respect Young Talent & Ignore Age Bias
advice_items.quote: People measure people's ages now still to this day. Oh, he's too young. He don't know... Wake up. He knows more than you.
advice_items.summary_en: Never underestimate young founders or judge capability by age.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要以年龄评判他人而应尊重年轻人的实力

guests.first_money_or_break: 在纽约布鲁克林威廉斯堡经营干洗店起家，通过掌控中心工厂并开设10家500平方英尺的收衣门店、同时向同行做批发实现规模化，十年前赚到第一个一百万，后出售业务转型开发科技App。
guests.guest_name: Williamsburg Dry Cleaning & Tech App Founder
guests.role_or_title: Former Dry Cleaning Chain Owner & Tech App Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Multi-millionaire; $50,000/month per 500 sq ft dry cleaning location (10 locations)

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Plan Ahead for Market & Life Downturns
advice_items.quote: Always plan for the future because today's sunshine will turn into tomorrow's rain. You may be wealthy today, you may lose everything tomorrow.
advice_items.summary_en: Prepare financially and strategically for downturns while times are good.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺境中必须居安思危为未来低谷做好规划

advice_items.quote: Happiness is a pursuit of your dream, pursuit of your mission, your purpose. Don't chase money and don't chase objects. Chase your purpose.
advice_items.summary_en: Pursue your mission and purpose rather than chasing money or material things.
advice_items.summary_zh: 追求人生使命与梦想而非单纯追逐金钱和物质

advice_items.quote: Started my own practice... Got to take a leap of faith. Got to trust in yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Trust yourself and take the leap of faith to start your own practice or business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相信自己并勇敢迈出独立创业的关键一步

advice_items.quote: I don't sell. My product sells. So, I take care of people. I care about people and people know that.
advice_items.summary_en: Win clients naturally by genuinely caring for people and letting quality speak.
advice_items.summary_zh: 真心关怀并服务好每一位客户让口碑自动获客

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Strive to Surpass Your Former Self
advice_items.quote: Being better than I was yesterday... True nobility is being superior to your former self.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on daily self-improvement rather than competing against others.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天超越过去的自己而非与他人攀比高低

advice_items.quote: Expand, hire other people, have other people work for you, have help. You got to have help cuz you can't carry the load on your shoulders.
advice_items.summary_en: Scale by hiring people and building support instead of carrying everything alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 扩张必须学会雇佣帮手不要独自扛下所有重担

advice_items.quote: Everybody's on the same playing field just like I am. I'm here. There's a homeless guy there. I'm not any better than anybody else.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble and treat every person as an equal regardless of wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持谦卑并平等对待身边的每一个人

advice_items.quote: Don't ever give up... Anything that's good is worth fighting for. And that journey is always hard.
advice_items.summary_en: Never quit when the journey gets hard because worthwhile rewards require the climb.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不轻言放弃因为值得拥有的一切都来之不易

guests.first_money_or_break: 39岁赚到第一个一百万，40岁时因创办自己的脊柱外科私人诊所并在过去一年赚到数百万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 顺境时要居安思危提前规划，勇敢走出舒适区独立创业，追求使命而非物质，通过真诚照顾客户和雇佣团队实现扩张。

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Own an Uncontested Niche & Rights Window
advice_items.quote: We own our space. So, nobody else can dominate travel like we can... Netflix created its own rights window... So, I stole that idea.
advice_items.summary_en: Dominate a specific distribution niche and turn competitors into partners and customers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 独占细分场景渠道并将竞争对手转化为客户与伙伴

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: Serve the person you're talking to... Never do something to somebody. Do something for someone.
advice_items.summary_en: Approach every deal and negotiation with a mindset of serving the other person.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判与交易的核心是真诚为对方创造服务价值

advice_items.quote: No is never no. It's always not yet.
advice_items.summary_en: Treat a prospect's 'no' as 'not yet' and keep following up.
advice_items.summary_zh: 面对客户拒绝时把“不”视为“暂时还没有”

advice_items.quote: I have run the same phone number for the last 32 years... your net worth is really your network... You got to get out and you got to be in person.
advice_items.summary_en: Show up in person, demonstrate commitment first, and keep long-term contact accessibility.
advice_items.summary_zh: 32年不换号并坚持线下露面建立长期铁杆人脉

advice_items.quote: Instagram and other things like people think it's overnight. Like some people call me now and say, 'Wow, this is amazing.' This is my ninth year.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be fooled by social media overnight-success myths; real businesses take years to build.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别被社媒一夜成名假象迷惑事业需要多年深耕

advice_items.quote: You can't tell me you appreciate being the winner if you don't appreciate the failures. Got to learn all of it to enjoy every single bit of it.
advice_items.summary_en: Appreciate and learn from every failure as part of the entrepreneurial journey.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会接纳并珍视失败才能真正享受胜利的果实

advice_items.quote: Every single day I love waking up. I'm up at 5. I'm up every day. Same energy you see me now. I have all day every day.
advice_items.summary_en: Wake up early at 5 a.m. and bring consistent high energy every single day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天清晨五点起床并保持始终如一的高能量状态

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒（祖父母仅二年级学历且靠收垃圾谋生），28岁在电脑与消费电子行业赚到第一个一百万，后依托技术背景创办机场和酒店电视网络Reach TV（并于2021年1月收购CNN Airport），单年最高收入达2.5亿美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 以服务心态做销售与谈判，把拒绝当成“暂时还没有”；长期保持同一联系方式并坚持线下露面兑现承诺；做好打多年持久战的准备，每天早起并全力投入。

advice_items.quote: I'm a fan of businesses that make real cash flow... boring businesses as well as financial services businesses that can achieve scale.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on scalable financial services and boring real-asset businesses like data centers and waste management that produce real cash flow.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资能产生真实稳定现金流的传统实体与金融业务

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: I feel like I knew enough, knew enough people, might as well start building.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn the playbook and build relationships in the industry before launching your own firm.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在行业内摸透规则并攒够人脉再出来单干创业

advice_items.quote: The team stands out. People I work with. I could do it alone, but it's much easier to go further with more people.
advice_items.summary_en: Stand out in competitive deal-making through the quality of your team.
advice_items.summary_zh: 依靠优秀团队协作在激烈竞争中脱颖而出走得更远

advice_items.quote: They don't want you to know that they need to lend money to people to make money... They make money on the spread, right?
advice_items.summary_en: Understand bank lending spreads, real cash flow versus EBITDA, and how cash compensation is taxed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 看懂银行息差逻辑、真实自由现金流与税务成本

advice_items.quote: You want to be able to think about money like it's air... you want to get to a point where money is like air.
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate an abundance mindset where money feels as natural and unstressed as breathing air.
advice_items.summary_zh: 培养把钱看得像空气一样自然充沛的富足心态

advice_items.quote: You just got to have a lot of hustle, hunger... I got an MBA as well... I had to stand out somehow, so I did that.
advice_items.summary_en: Bring relentless hustle, hunger, and credentials to stand out when breaking into competitive finance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠强烈饥饿感、拼搏精神与硬核学历在金融圈突围

advice_items.quote: You have to network your ass off... You got to run. You got to spend a lot of shoe leather.
advice_items.summary_en: Put in heavy legwork to network relentlessly and get into the right rooms.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不辞辛劳跑断腿般疯狂拓展高质量人脉进入核心圈层

guests.first_money_or_break: 非富裕家庭出身，凭借本科和MBA学历、强烈拼搏精神及疯狂拓展人脉进入华尔街私募股权行业，最高年收入50万美元（自述尚未达到百万富翁），目前正在创立自己的私募股权公司。
guests.guest_name: Wall Street Private Equity Firm Founder
guests.zero_start_advice: 凭借高学历和拼劲在人群中脱颖而出，脚踏实地大量线下拓展人脉；聚焦能产生真实现金流的传统实体或可规模化金融服务行业，积累经验与人脉后组建团队创业。
